environment.description: Ktor microservice deployed on EKS behind AWS API Gateway (HTTP API type) with a request validation configuration. The API Gateway route PUT /api/v1/users/{userId}/profile has an associated model schema (content-type application/json) that defines the request body as an object with ONLY 'displayName' (string, maxLength 64), 'email' (string, format email), and 'metadata' (object with additionalProperties of type string). The model uses 'additionalProperties: false' at the root level. Request validation is configured with 'validateRequestBody: true' on the integration. Note: the API Gateway model validation uses draft-04 JSON Schema and the gateway returns 400 before forwarding if extra properties exist. The userId path parameter is also validated as matching pattern '^user-[0-9]{3}$'. Headers X-Authenticated-User and X-User-Role are injected by a Lambda authorizer attached to the route (not passable by client).

config.lambda_authorizer: injects X-Authenticated-User and X-User-Role from JWT claims, strips client-supplied values
